 (
  MedicaidID Varchar(14),						  
  FILENAME Varchar(100),			
  FILENAME_Row_num INT
 )

 INSERT INTO ##Temp_MAX_FILENAME
select MedicaidID,				
	   FILENAME,
	   dense_rank() over (partition by MedicaidID order by ImportDate Desc) FILENAME_Row_num
	from [dbo].[Kentucky_Enrollment_HlthCov](NOLOCK) 	
	 WHere HlthCovPlanType in ('ELG','MNC','MFI')

source.sqlReaderQuery: select distinct A.MedicaidID, 		A.SeqNumEnroll, 		A.SeqNumEnrollHlth, 		A.HlthCovMaintTypeCd, 		A.HlthCovInsCd, 		A.HlthCovPlanType, 		A.HlthCovOcc, 		A.HlthCovPgmAssgnCd, 		A.HlthCovPgmIMID, 		A.HlthCovStatus, 		A.HlthCovContactCd, 		A.HlthCovMedicallyFrail, 		A.HlthCovDeductibleYr, 		A.HlthCovLiabInd, 		A.HlthCovLTCInd, 		A.HlthCovTransDt, 		A.HlthCovInd, 		A.HlthCovBgnDt, 		A.HlthCovEndDt, 		A.HlthCovSigngDt, 		A.HlthCovCommEngHrs, 		A.HlthCovFastTrkInd, 		A.HlthCovLinkMemberID, 		A.HlthCovMonetaryAmt, 		A.HlthCovLevelCd, 		A.HlthCovContractAmt, 		A.HlthCovContractREF, 		A.HlthCovProviderNo	  from     ##Temp_MAX_FILENAME b     INNER JOIN [dbo].[Kentucky_Enrollment_HlthCov](NOLOCK) A ON b.MedicaidID = A.MedicaidID 	AND b.Filename=A.Filename AND A.HlthCovPlanType in ('ELG','MNC','MFI')  Where b.FILENAME_Row_num=1 	AND	(A.HlthCovPlanType in ('MFI') or 			 ( A.HlthCovPlanType in ('ELG','MNC')  			   and  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), getdate(), 112) between A.HlthCovBgnDt 										 and case when A.HlthCovEndDt=99991231 Then CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), getdate(), 112) 											 Else A.HlthCovEndDt End  			 ) 		)
